summary: Create a marketing website for XYZ Events, a nationwide (50 states) event production labor provider with 15+ years of experience supporting large hotels and event venues, offering audio, event production, LED walls, projection, video recording, engineering/switching, and conference general sessions with breakout rooms.
architectural_notes: Services section: increase selected service card/box overlay fill to white at ~20% opacity (instead of ~5%) to improve text readability.
known_issues: Service category text labels on the Services cards (e.g., Audio, LED Wall, etc.) are still very hard to read over the photos; increase overlay strength and/or adjust text styling (size/weight/shadow) to improve readability.
Services cards overlay opacity is still too low for readability; increase the white overlay to ~20% transparency/opacity to improve text contrast over photos.

existing_features.title: Create a responsive marketing homepage for “XYZ Events” that clearly communicates the company is an event production labor provider operating throughout all 50 U.S. states with 15+ years of experience supporting large hotel and event venues.

Add a services section that lists the offered event production labor capabilities: audio, event production, LED walls, projection, video recording, engineering and switching, and support for large conferences with general sessions and multiple breakout rooms.
Add a nationwide coverage and venues section emphasizing support across all 50 U.S. states and experience working in large hotel and event venues.

Add a contact section suitable for a marketing website without requiring backend persistence: include a simple contact form UI that uses a mailto link fallback (or displays contact details) so users can reach the company.

Implement a coherent visual theme for the site (colors, typography, spacing, and component styling) that fits an event-production labor brand and apply it consistently across all sections; do not use a blue/purple theme.
Add basic SEO and share metadata for the marketing page (document title and description) referencing XYZ Events and nationwide event production labor services.
Include generated static image assets in the frontend and use them in the hero/sections; store them under frontend/public/assets/generated and reference them directly from the UI.

Generate and add one category-specific background image for each of the six service categories (Audio Production, Event Production, LED Wall & Projection, Video Recording, Engineering & Switching, Conference Support) as static assets under frontend/public/assets/generated.

Update the Services section UI to display a category-specific background for each service card (or equivalent per-service UI element), ensuring text/icon readability via an overlay (e.g., gradient/blur/tint) and maintaining responsive layout.

Update the selected Services card text-overlay element (XPath: /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/main[1]/section[2]/div[1]/div[2]/div[1]/div[3]/div[2]/div[1]) so it is less transparent and the text is easier to read against the service background image. Implement this by increasing the opacity/strength of the overlay gradient used for readability in the Services section cards, without changing other sections.

Update the Services section service-card overlay treatment so the category titles and descriptions (e.g., “Audio Production”, “LED Wall & Projection”, etc.) are clearly readable over the background photos on all cards.

Adjust Services card typography styling to further increase contrast and legibility over imagery (e.g., stronger font weight/size and/or text shadow/outline and/or placing the title/description on a higher-contrast scrim), while keeping the existing layout responsive.

Update ONLY the 12 selected elements in the Services section (section[2] service cards) to use a white background fill with 5% opacity (i.e., 0.05 alpha / Tailwind equivalent like bg-white/5) to improve text readability, without changing any other elements on the page.
